questions.question: Why did the lecturer choose to focus on the Pleasanton Town Market?

analyses.content: 录音明确指出市场之所以重要，是因为它经常在图书馆的文献中被提及，对应选项C。
录音中用“not like”直接否定了这是第一个市场（排除A选项），且全文完全没有提到当地历史课（排除B选项）。

Now, why are we talking all about some market? It's not like it was the 1st market ever, or even a particularly large market. The Pleasanton Town Market is important because it is often mentioned in the literature found in the library.

questions.question: The Town Market originally made a large profit selling

analyses.content: 录音提到人们从世界各地来寻找最大最好的牛、猪和鸡（livestock 牲畜），对应选项C的动物（animals）。
录音明确指出手工艺品（handcrafted items）是“现在（now）”卖的，而非“最初（originally）”；且录音中从未提到卖蔬菜（vegetables）。

If you have ever been there, you have probably seen all of the handcrafted items sold there now. But what was originally bought and sold in the town market? In the beginning, the market sold products such as meats, furs, and simple tools. Over time, though, it became known as the place to find quality livestock. People came from all over the world to find the biggest and best cows, pigs, and chickens.

questions.question: The money that the marketers made contributes to local

analyses.content: 录音提到商贩将利润捐出，结果带来了一段快速发展的时期（a period of rapid development came about），对应选项B（development）。原文的 contributing their profits（捐出利润）对应题干的 The money that the marketers made（商贩赚的钱）。原文的 as a result of... came about（作为……的结果而产生）对应题干的 contributes to（促成了/导致了）。
录音开头明确用“Not to be confused with...”直接排除了重建（Reconstruction）；而防御（defense）只是利润投入的诸多具体设施之一，整体对当地产生的贡献是发展（development），所以 defense 是以偏概全的错误答案。

Not to be confused with the Reconstruction Era, a period of rapid development came about in the 1660s as a result of the market's vendors contributing their profits to building up much needed public facilities and defense, which would later make a huge impact on the outcome of the war.

questions.question: Market sales plummeted due to a lack of viable

analyses.content: 录音指出顾客越来越不愿意“travel”（长途跋涉）去镇中心买肉，这种出行上的困难阻力对应选项B的交通（transport）。
录音中提到的是农业的进步和革命（排除了农业匮乏的选项A），而城市规划（town planning）是利润下降后需要采取的解决措施，并非导致利润下降的原因（排除选项C）。

However, as revolutions in farming came about, more people moved to farms far from the city center. Customers grew more and more reluctant to travel all the way to the town center for their meats when they could easily choose to buy from local farmers near them for a fraction of the price. With such a fall in the profits of the town's major profit generator, some quality town planning was needed.

questions.question: Mayor John C. Wiley decided the Clock tower would be used as a ........ in the early stages of the uprising.

analyses.content: 录音提到市长在这座建筑里判处了所有人终身监禁（prison sentences），随后它作为一个监狱存在了50年，对应选项C的jail（监狱）。
大钟（clock）只是用于识别这座建筑的外部标志，不能作为其用途；而战斗场地（grounds for battle）在录音中完全没有提及。

The building with the large clock was a landmark that had symbolized growth in Pleasanton for a generation. Wylie decided to use the notoriety of the town market to set an example. During the historical Rotterdam Rebellion, Wylie gave all those involved lifetime prison sentences in the very same building. It stayed a prison for about 50 more years until they transported all remaining prisoners to other facilities and turned it into the historical monument today.

analyses.content: 录音首先提到研究方法：“...look through the library's reference section...”（定位成功）。紧接着提出建议与研究对象：“I suggest starting by looking for information on the market itself.”（指出研究对象是 market）。最后提到关于它的信息太多了（too much information），完美契合题干。
你可能会在听的时候抓取到information等周边词汇，但题干这里需要填入的是具体的研究对象（Objects），不要忽略整体语义。

I will give you some class time to look through the library's reference section, but you will be responsible for conducting further research outside of class. I suggest starting by looking for information on the market itself. You'll find plenty of information. In fact, some students complain that there is actually too much information on it.
录音明确提到你可以去找老兵的家属进行“interviews”（采访），作为一种具体的研究方法。
你可能会听到family members或veterans，但表格这一列考察的是研究方法（Research Methods），只有动词conduct后面的interviews才符合要求。
On your own time, you could find family members of old war veterans to conduct interviews.
录音直接提到，充满偏见的采访是“useless”（无用的），直接对应题干bias makes it...。
前面虽然提到了wonderful insight（绝佳的见解），但那是没有偏见时的情况，一定要跟上转折词but，识别出bias后面的真正结果。
Sometimes they provide wonderful insight that you wouldn't find in proper history books. But be careful. An interview that is riddled with bias is useless.
录音提到我有一些非常老的“photographs”（照片），其中包括Jim Wylie的照片，直接锁定了研究物品。
注意不要填入inspiration，它只是看照片可能带来的结果，表格这一列需要的是具体的研究对象。

I myself have some very old photographs here that you are welcome to take a look at for some inspiration. I'm lucky enough to own this one of Jim Wylie himself. Very interesting to see, but does not provide enough information to add much to your film.
录音指示要去查看报纸档案中的“crime”（犯罪）版块（section），准确命中题干定位词。
你可能会被前面的thriller或outlaws干扰，但只有紧跟在newspaper archives（报纸档案）这一显性定位词后面的crime才是填空处的正解。

All you would have to do is look through the newspaper archives in the crime section during that time period. Try to get as much detail as you can, but you may end up having to draw your own conclusions.
